headline: US–Iran Retaliation Heightens Tensions… World Economy Back to Zero Visibility
summary: The United States resumed attacks on Iran about a month after the last round and said it will respond firmly to Iran's provocations rather than negotiate. Commentary says the world economy is back to zero visibility.
why: Military escalation between the US and Iran affects oil supply risk, shipping routes in the Gulf region, and global risk sentiment. Investors track these developments closely for energy and currency exposure.
why_moved: Renewed US strikes on Iran and an announced firm response raise geopolitical risk, which typically pressures risk assets and lifts demand for safe havens and oil-supply hedges.
